_comment: GGUF model catalog for the Sylvia TTS server (RealtimeTTS / Qwen3-TTS).
Paths in 'file' are relative to 'models_root'. 'models_root' may be absolute or
relative to the realtime-tts-server directory. Entries with "optional": true are
documented slots: they are listed as MISSING until the file is dropped in place.
roles: serve = usable by --model for the HTTP server, design = usable to generate
device_profiles hold the native flags per device; default_device 'auto' picks gpu
when the CUDA runtime is installed (Start-TTS-GPU.bat), cpu otherwise (Start-TTS.bat).

talkers.label: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B Base
talkers.note: default; voice cloning from the sylvia reference, fastest on CPU

talkers.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base
talkers.note: voice cloning; better prosody than 0.6B, roughly 3x slower on CPU

talkers.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B CustomVoice
talkers.note: preset speakers + instructions; no reference cloning

talkers.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B VoiceDesign
talkers.note: designs a voice from .config/voice-profile.txt; used to build the reference

talkers.label: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B Base
talkers.note: 0.6B at near-lossless precision; safe default for GPU and CPU

talkers.label: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B VoiceDesign
talkers.note: highest-fidelity reference builder, 3.6 GB; needs GPU (fits 8 GB VRAM)
